{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the College of Nursing & Health Innovation at Arizona State University.
We are proud to offer a Bachelor’s of Science in Health Care Coordination. Offered at both ASU’s Downtown Phoenix and West campuses, this degree program prepares graduates to collaborate with individuals, families and integrated multidisciplinary teams to meet complex health needs while navigating current and future trends in public policy that affect the delivery of health care.
Through this major, students gain knowledge and skills related to health care systems, community and public health, community resources, health education, and health advocacy. Additionally, students build a strong foundation in health science.
You can view more information about Health Care Coordination including employment opportunities and a major map online.
If you are ready to join the Sun Devil community, apply now for admission.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please respond to this email or call our office at 602-496-0937 and we will be happy to assist.
Sincerely,
College of Nursing and Health Innovation Phone: 602-496-0937 Office Hours: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. asu.hcc@asu.edu nursingandhealth.asu.edu
